long_biography.plain_text:
In 1967, Richard “Dickie” Gonsoulin began a supplier relationship that endured for decades at LeBeouf Bros. Towing. Karl Senner supplied a German gearbox for the company, and the two men became close friends. Senner’s firm kept replacement gears locally so LeBeouf could return boats to service quickly.

Gonsoulin also served as president of Gonsoulin Industries, formed in 1977 to house LeBeouf and associated industrial businesses. These included steel supply, diesel repairs, construction and Bourg Dry Dock. The shipyard remains part of LeBeouf’s operations, building and repairing commercial boats and barges alongside the towing business.
